key_constraints: Root initial header budget1000 is not enforced.
Child headers debit parent by actual bytes; child detach debits parent by full declared payload.
Node destruction never seeks unread bytes; explicit skip does.
No node retains its parent or reader; only reader owns stream reference.
Native remaining predicate checks nonzero DWORD only.
Native fixed path has10 slots without guard.
Nonnull-count scalar short reads preserve pointer-seed bits; null-count font adapter is not equivalent.
Control word meaning unknown; loader dispatch reads it without validation.
No payload fit, underflow, recursion, allocator, source validity or stream success checks in audited wrappers.

dependencies.note: Existing loader consumer attaches stream, creates root, dispatches and releases.
Calls control read then depth-first child traversal; missing concrete type parsers remain separate.
Initial ordinary reader path zeroes buffer triplet.
Allocation internals/failure behavior not newly audited.
Full-read actual-count and x87 semantics established in STRUCTURED_RESOURCE_HIERARCHY_BOUNDS.md.
